patch_description: Replace random points with an actual optimization: parameterize 14 free points in R^3, and directly maximize dmin/dmax using a smooth soft-min/soft-max surrogate minimized by L-BFGS-B over multiple fixed-seed restarts (including structured starts like the icosahedron). After optimization, we shift/scale so the configuration is centered and normalized (objective is invariant to this). The smooth surrogate (log-sum-exponential of distances) is differentiable, letting BFGS make progress on this non-smooth objective; the best restart by the true ratio is kept. This should raise the ratio from ~0 (random points often have near-coincident min distances) to near the reference ~0.49.
